title: Tags are duplicated at every subgraph level since 1.2.3 (2^depth copies)
observed_behavior: An invoke-time tag 'my-tag' reaches the leaf node once at depth 0 but 2, 4 and 8 times at nesting depths 1, 2 and 3. The duplication is visible in config['tags'] inside nodes (and in callbacks/astream_events); metadata is unaffected.
structure_focus: Nested compiled subgraphs as nodes; config/tag propagation across graph boundaries (2^depth concatenation)
notes: Open, label external. The fixture mirrors build(depth) nesting and reads config['tags'] in the leaf; on pre-1.2.3 versions it prints 1x at every depth. Root cause per issue: ensure_config merges explicit tags onto ambient tags since #7926 changed overwrite to merge, and every subgraph level re-adds the same tags. Comments reference PR #9110 with a dedupe fix. Not a state-graph composition hazard in the ACR sense; tags/config propagation is outside the current rule set.
